result_label: accepted finite native busy and request-identity disposition slice; not production or real model proof

time_scope.suite: Three worker stages, controlled kills/reopens, SQLite copies and frozen acceptance; excludes runtime authentication.
time_scope.controller: Begins inside execute before source/runtime authentication; excludes interpreter startup/imports.
time_scope.complete_CLI: Python process creation/startup/imports, source/runtime authentication, suite/workers/restarts/copies/audit/exit
time_scope.complete_CLI_excludes: Protocol preparation, independent reviews, prior pure regressions and later publication/checks

terminal_latency_ms.scope: 14 mixed host dispositions including deliberate holds, restart and collision quarantine; descriptive, not inference about model latency or SLO.

metrics.quality_and_success_scope: 14/14 durable host records reached their intended finite disposition; four native final inputs completed normally. Two cancelled-after-effect controls also committed one local effect each. No model-quality or generalized task-success estimate.
metrics.committed_state_evidence_scope: The callback events satisfy their recorded invariants. Each saved SQLite stage copy retains the latest service revision because checkpointWhen checkpoints each revision; intermediate callback events cannot all be rejoined to retained historical DB revisions. Each stage full SQL endpoint/latest sequence/state and stopped-source/copy equality are separately checked.
metrics.cost_scope: Complete-CLI effects/s includes authentication and startup, but excludes preparation/reviews/publication. Callback/flush totals are partial measured observation components, not marginal observer overhead. Sampled private maxima and OS peak working set are distinct endpoints; worker start/end intervals and polling gaps are unobserved. Controller/launcher process memory and communication were not benchmarked.

engineering.actual_caller: Same optional two-SQLite-Session Harness/Conversation/GenerationTask/official local Faux/ToolTask service.
engineering.scale_bottleneck: Native busy errors leave host capacity reserved; native request-ID deduplication is type/ID based and cannot authenticate content for host recovery. Blind cancellation can abort another native identity.
engineering.integration_point: Same reconciliation and cancellation methods; exact input identity checked before abort, conflict permanently releases only host-owned capacity with original native ID recorded. No native store or runtime edits.
engineering.rollback: Separate optional module and controller; all old source/freeze/result bytes retained. Do not swap an existing production caller implicitly.
engineering.validated_tier_if_passed: Finite single-owner Windows native lifecycle using deterministic official local Faux; no real model, HTTP, tenant/concurrent-owner or external effect guarantee.

next_gate: CLOSED: the finite native busy/error/request-ID-collision caller has completed its preregistered gate. Do not repeat it or extend isolated observer/diagnostic prerequisites. Next H2 work must separately preregister the same native ToolTask boundary with a recoverable independently persisted effect and free local HTTP transport, current authority and idempotency across two process restarts, bounded admission/cancellation and explicit latency/resource/observation limits. This does not authorize a real model, paid API, production deployment or a concurrent-owner/external exactly-once claim.
limits: One trusted Windows host, two native SQLite Sessions, deterministic official local Faux, no real model or HTTP transport. Same-ID changed-content reuse is an observed native contract, not automatically an upstream defect. Quarantine releases only host capacity; fixture-owner cleanup uses Conversation-wide abort after observing the foreign placed record unchanged. Native abort itself resumes the scheduler: finite no-replay evidence is not a globally paused scheduler or native per-ID placed-input abort guarantee. Equivalent-JSON post-quarantine effect protection has pure regression evidence only. Authority check and native submit are separate commits; concurrent permission-change, owner and cancellation races, tenant authentication, native storage failure, arbitrary crash-log durability, independent/external effects, real network/model, distributed/GPU and production behavior remain untested. Arrival is serial and gates are controlled; histories grow and reconcile/reap are explicit. checkpointWhen checkpoints each service document revision, so each saved stage copy retains its latest service revision; intermediate committed-state events cannot all be independently joined to historical database rows. Event invariants and each stage latest full SQL endpoint/sequence/state plus stopped-source/copy equality were checked. Memory/output polling and SQLite deadline callbacks bound observations, not unsampled peaks or uninterruptible OS I/O. No matched baseline, observer-OFF arm, quality benchmark, communication benchmark, causal overhead/speedup or SLO proof. Prior H2 failures/results, H1 negative outcomes and original 5 GiB gate, and H3/H4 objects/states are unchanged.

preflight.scope: Preparation fake-Harness/synthetic-freeze evidence, distinct from the single native suite.
